pose: Climbing a vertical volcanic rock face. The Anchiornis is oriented vertically, using its clawed wings and legs to grip the stone. The long, feathered tail hangs straight down, and the head is tilted upward toward the top of the 1024px frame. This posture naturally fills the tall aspect ratio while maintaining accurate bird-like proportions. Friendly, bright-eyed expression.
